answer.says: No, thank you, Sunil. I have eaten enough. The haze is thick; I must return to the bungalow.
answer.thought: Sunil's offer is the particularity of the moment, a steam that rises and dissipates. I have no use for more food, and the heat is oppressive. I must return to my solitude to face the silence of the unpaid wage and the pending orders.
